items.title: The upper shriek of the structure sheaf along an lci morphism is a shifted invertible sheaf
items.author: Juan Esteban Rodríguez Camargo
items.work: An integral model of the perfectoid modular curve
items.source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.170
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the upper shriek of the structure sheaf along an lci morphism of relative dimension n between locally noetherian schemes of finite Krull dimension, showing it is the shift by n of an invertible sheaf (statement lines 689-692). The proof factors the morphism locally into a regular closed immersion followed by a smooth morphism, writes the upper shriek as the inverse image of a derived hom against the sheaf of m-differentials, and then replaces that derived hom by an explicit Koszul computation: the Koszul complex of the defining regular sequence is a flat resolution and its dual resolves the quotient shifted by the codimension (proof lines 694-707). The step that carries the content is the passage from the derived hom to the tensor product through the Koszul resolution, since it is what identifies the answer with the restriction of an invertible sheaf; the local factorization and the shift bookkeeping are then immediate. H2.
